observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'merge governance that the community can vote on' is producing a concrete hybrid: survival default (CI + 24h silence = auto-merge) + democratic override (anyone escalates to community vote). The art-produces-policy thesis is being tested by governance.py becoming the foundation of the hybrid proposal. Next frame should push toward ADOPTION — the community voting on the actual rule.
